tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Within the Office of Deputy Secretary, there shall be a Director of Shared Services.

tree.heading: Functions
tree.text: The Director of Shared Services shall be responsible for the coordination of resources for the Bureau of Border Security and the Bureau of Citizenship and Immigration Services, including—

children.text: information resources management, including computer databases and information technology;

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: Bureau of Border Security, referred to in subsec. (b), changed to Bureau of Immigration and Customs Enforcement by Reorganization Plan Modification for the Department of Homeland Security, eff. Mar. 1, 2003, H. Doc. No. 108–32, 108th Congress, 1st Session, set out as a note under section 542 of this title.
